scope: Pinned MuJoCo 3.10.0 public Python class/member, runtime-field, option-field, global-function, header-function, and package-counterpart catalogues. Catalogued upstream surfaces are not implementations or qualification.

mj_angmomMat.semantics: Owned batched world-axis angular-momentum matrix about subtree COM. Native runtime pose/inertia/Jacobian operations; CPU oracles and native qualification recorded separately.

mj_subtreeVel.semantics: Owned full-state subtree COM velocity and angular momentum, world axes; nonmutating query does not update upstream sleep-filtered sensor cache.

mj_local2Global.semantics: Owned batched local-to-world position/rotation, all five pinned sameframe values; optional outputs and unnormalized local quaternions follow pinned C behavior.

mj_mulJacVec.semantics: Owned product from coherent prepared canonical constraint rows; reserved inactive rows/failed worlds zero; sparse Jacobian consumed without dense materialization.

mj_mulJacTVec.semantics: Owned product from coherent prepared canonical constraint rows; reserved inactive rows/failed worlds zero; sparse Jacobian consumed without dense materialization.

mj_rne.semantics: Owned full-state rigid-body recursive Newton-Euler force; optional acceleration term, excludes armature and applied/passive/actuation/constraint forces; does not mutate sleep caches.

mj_stateSize.semantics: Pinned upstream mjtState flat vector width from host model metadata; distinct from backend StateSpec dictionary interface.

mj_extractState.semantics: Owned batched device vector extraction in pinned upstream mjtState ordering; no value readback, destination is subset of source.

mj_kinematics.semantics: Owned full-state body/inertia/geom/site/joint Cartesian fields from native kinematics; no persistent sleep-cache mutation.

mj_comPos.semantics: Owned subtree COM, root-COM-referenced spatial inertia and motion DOFs from native stage; zero-mass fallback follows pinned inertial position.

mj_comVel.semantics: Owned complete COM-frame velocity and motion-DOF time derivatives from native smooth VEL stage; no persistent sleep-cache mutation.

mj_rnePostConstraint.semantics: Owned native post-constraint spatial acceleration/internal/external wrench fields; rollback transaction and optional coherent forward bundle/qacc override; source force composition and batched status contract documented in API.

mj_transmission.semantics: Current-state POS query returning owned batched actuator lengths and explicit dense moment rows; velocities belong to VEL. Native qualification tracked separately.
